headline: Currency Markets Remain Subdued Ahead of Pivotal Central Bank Decisions
summary: Currency markets traded quietly as investors awaited crucial monetary policy announcements from central banks scheduled for the upcoming week.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions and monetary policy outlooks are primary drivers of foreign exchange rate volatility and asset pricing.

impacts.name: EUR/USD
impacts.why: Anticipation of central bank rate decisions suppresses immediate directional movement in foreign exchange markets.

why_moved: Traders typically reduce positioning and volatility decreases ahead of major macroeconomic policy announcements.
